name: com.qudmi.fullbody
description:
Full-body avatar motion from a VR headset and two hand controllers, running on-device in real time. Add one component to a Humanoid-rigged avatar -- no ML code, no extra trackers, no per-joint wiring. Includes a setup wizard and a demo scene that runs without VR hardware.

The package code is MIT. The trained weights are downloaded separately (Window > Qudmi > Download Model Weights) because they are trained on AMASS and licensed for non-commercial research use only -- they may not be shipped in a commercial product.
